# Diddums

> A browser music workstation. Every sound is synthesised live by small DSP programs. Pieces are JSON "Songs" that can be opened from a link.

- [Diddums song skill](https://danbri.github.io/diddums/skill/SKILL.md): how to compose a Song and turn it into a playable https://danbri.github.io/diddums/?song=… link. Provider-neutral; usable by any LLM or agent.
- [Example piece](https://danbri.github.io/diddums/?piece=firstcontact): First Contact, 70 seconds.
- [Source](https://github.com/danbri/diddums)
